title: Hunters report total silence just before a companion vanished

tellings.quote: And the ones who come back saying right before he disappeared, right before Charlie disappeared, there was no sound.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani passes on a story from Missing 411, a collection of cases about people who disappeared in wild places. According to that account, hunters out in the American wilderness lost a companion called Charlie, and the ones who came back said that right before he vanished, everything went completely silent. Jorjani tells it because, if true, it would hint that something strange happens around these disappearances.
